blocked_scope: external fused or dynamic-arrival production serving beyond the checked static continuous-batching adapter
available_evidence: the checked static continuous-batching adapter and the P4 reference PyTorch matrix remain executable and are reported separately
missing_requirements: an external fused serving runtime or a scheduler supporting dynamic arrivals and continuous admission
official runtime and source revision provenance for that external backend
failure_policy: never relabel checked static batching, reference, projected, or serial-interleaved measurements as external fused or dynamic-serving evidence
resolution: provide an external executable conforming to p4-production-systems-matrix-v1.json and rerun the same frozen Cartesian matrix
claim_boundary: The blocker does not invalidate measurements from the checked static continuous-batching adapter, but those results cannot establish dynamic-arrival, fused-kernel, multi-GPU, or official DeepSeek-V4 serving performance.
